params.prompt: Precise prop-geometry repair of IMAGE ONE. Preserve its exact Astrid pose, face, hair, long black sleeves, extended arm, camera, table, shoe and background. Replace ONLY the oversized face-up card beneath the extended fingertips with a correctly sized FLAT card. This is an ORTHOGRAPHIC fixed camera: the SAME card sliding on the SAME flat felt does NOT get larger as it moves towards the viewer. Match the card's PROJECTED WIDTH, PROJECTED HEIGHT, angle and foreshortening to the small flat face-up card in IMAGE TWO. Translate that small planar quadrilateral to the destination under the fingertips in IMAGE ONE; do not scale it up or stand it upright. Its trailing edge remains under the existing fingertips; the leading edge extends a short distance forward from them. Keep its white paper and queen-of-spades artwork. Restore green felt wherever the old oversized card is removed. No changes to the fingers, no floating card, no extra cards. The final card must look small and strongly flattened against felt, exactly like image TWO's card but at the new position.
